item.title: By: Eric Reiss
item.dc:creator: Eric Reiss
item.description:
I, too, like Mike Kuniavsky’s definition, but find it a bit vague. And Thomas Baekdal’s “make it easy to be happy” doesn’t provide a very concise framework either.

The NNGroup understands the critical role of interaction, but fails to put this observation into its much greater perspective.

Might I contribute the following to the discussion:
http://www.fatdux.com/blog/2009/01/10/a-definition-of-user-experience/

item.title: By: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description:
You might want to look at Tiltools UX Radar for a new spider-chart version of Morville’s Honeycomb:

Based on the UX Honeycomb, I have designed a UX evaluation tool – the UX Radar. This tool allows evaluating products/services and clearly seeing their similarities and differences from a UX perspective. It also allows seeing changes in the product/service design process and monitoring the UX evolution.
